audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim centralized-worship, slaughter, blood, and anti-idolatry law, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for destruction of local cult sites, the chosen place, household rejoicing, local slaughter, blood prohibition, Levite inclusion, vow/holy-gift centralization, land expansion, and child-sacrifice warning.

verses.restored: These are statutes and judgments you shall keep to do in land YHWH Divine of your fathers gives you to possess, all days you live upon ground.

familiar.text: These are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.

modern.text: These are the statutes and ordinances you must be careful to follow all the days you live in the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess.

original.text: אֵ֠לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְר֣וּן לַעֲשׂוֹת֒ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֧י אֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ לְךָ֖ לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ כָּל הַיָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּ֥ם חַיִּ֖ים עַל הָאֲדָמָֽה

verses.restored: You shall surely destroy all places where nations whom you dispossess served their gods, upon high mountains, hills, and under every leafy tree.

familiar.text: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:

modern.text: Destroy completely all the places where the nations you are dispossessing have served their gods—atop the high mountains, on the hills, and under every green tree.

original.text: אַבֵּ֣ד תְּ֠אַבְּדוּן אֶֽת כָּל הַמְּקֹמ֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֧ר עָֽבְדוּ שָׁ֣ם הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם יֹרְשִׁ֥ים אֹתָ֖ם אֶת אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם עַל הֶהָרִ֤ים הָֽרָמִים֙ וְעַל הַגְּבָע֔וֹת וְתַ֖חַת כָּל עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָן

verses.restored: You shall tear down their altars, smash their pillars, burn their Asherah poles with fire, cut down carved images of their gods, and destroy their name from that place.

familiar.text: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.

modern.text: Tear down their altars, smash their sacred pillars, burn up their Asherah poles, cut down the idols of their gods, and wipe out their names from every place.

original.text: וְנִתַּצְתֶּ֣ם אֶת מִזְבּחֹתָ֗ם וְשִׁבַּרְתֶּם֙ אֶת מַצֵּ֣בֹתָ֔ם וַאֲשֵֽׁרֵיהֶם֙ תִּשְׂרְפ֣וּן בָּאֵ֔שׁ וּפְסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֖ם תְּגַדֵּע֑וּן וְאִבַּדְתֶּ֣ם אֶת שְׁמָ֔ם מִן הַמָּק֖וֹם הַהֽוּא

verses.restored: You shall not do so to YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.

modern.text: You shall not worship the LORD your God in this way.

original.text: לֹֽא תַעֲשׂ֣וּן כֵּ֔ן לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: But to place YHWH your Divine chooses from all your tribes to put his name there, to his dwelling you shall seek, and there you shall come.

familiar.text: But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:

modern.text: Instead, you must seek the place the LORD your God will choose from among all your tribes to establish as a dwelling for His Name, and there you must go.

original.text: כִּ֠י אִֽם אֶל הַמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ מִכָּל שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֔ם לָשׂ֥וּם אֶת שְׁמ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם לְשִׁכְנ֥וֹ תִדְרְשׁ֖וּ וּבָ֥אתָ שָֽׁמָּה

verses.restored: There you shall bring burnt offerings, sacrifices, tithes, contribution of your hand, vows, freewill offerings, and firstborn of herd and flock.

familiar.text: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:

modern.text: To that place you are to bring your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and heave offerings, your vow offerings and freewill offerings, as well as the firstborn of your herds and flocks.

original.text: וַהֲבֵאתֶ֣ם שָׁ֗מָּה עֹלֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וְזִבְחֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֵת֙ מַעְשְׂרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יֶדְכֶ֑ם וְנִדְרֵיכֶם֙ וְנִדְבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּבְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקַרְכֶ֖ם וְצֹאנְכֶֽם

verses.restored: There you shall eat before YHWH your Divine and rejoice, you and your households, in all undertaking of your hand in which YHWH your Divine blessed you.

familiar.text: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.

modern.text: There, in the presence of the LORD your God, you and your households shall eat and rejoice in all you do, because the LORD your God has blessed you.

original.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם שָׁ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם בְּכֹל֙ מִשְׁלַ֣ח יֶדְכֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם וּבָתֵּיכֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽרַכְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: You shall not do according to all we do here today, each man whatever is right in his own eyes,

familiar.text: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.

modern.text: You are not to do as we are doing here today, where everyone does what seems right in his own eyes.

original.text: לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּן כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנַ֧חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֛ים פֹּ֖ה הַיּ֑וֹם אִ֖ישׁ כָּל הַיָּשָׁ֥ר בְּעֵינָֽיו

verses.restored: for until now you have not come to rest and inheritance YHWH your Divine gives you.

familiar.text: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.

modern.text: For you have not yet come to the resting place and the inheritance that the LORD your God is giving you.

original.text: כִּ֥י לֹא בָּאתֶ֖ם עַד עָ֑תָּה אֶל הַמְּנוּחָה֙ וְאֶל הַֽנַּחֲלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ

verses.restored: When you cross Jordan and dwell in land YHWH your Divine causes you to inherit, and he gives rest from all enemies around and you dwell securely,

familiar.text: But when ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God giveth you to inherit, and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;

modern.text: When you cross the Jordan and live in the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and He gives you rest from all the enemies around you and you dwell securely,

original.text: וַעֲבַרְתֶּם֮ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֣ם בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מַנְחִ֣יל אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְהֵנִ֨יחַ לָכֶ֧ם מִכָּל אֹיְבֵיכֶ֛ם מִסָּבִ֖יב וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם בֶּֽטַח

verses.restored: then to place YHWH your Divine chooses to cause his name to dwell, there you shall bring all I command: burnt offerings, sacrifices, tithes, contribution of your hand, and all choice vows you vow to YHWH.

familiar.text: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD:

modern.text: then the LORD your God will choose a dwelling for His Name. And there you are to bring everything I command you: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, and all the choice offerings you vow to the LORD.

original.text: וְהָיָ֣ה הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֥ם בּוֹ֙ לְשַׁכֵּ֤ן שְׁמוֹ֙ שָׁ֔ם שָׁ֣מָּה תָבִ֔יאוּ אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֑ם עוֹלֹתֵיכֶ֣ם וְזִבְחֵיכֶ֗ם מַעְשְׂרֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וּתְרֻמַ֣ת יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְכֹל֙ מִבְחַ֣ר נִדְרֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּדְּר֖וּ לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: You shall rejoice before YHWH your Divine—you, your sons, daughters, male servants, female servants, and Levite within your gates, for he has no portion or inheritance with you.

familiar.text: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.

modern.text: And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates, since he has no portion or inheritance among you.

original.text: וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵי֮ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֒ אַתֶּ֗ם וּבְנֵיכֶם֙ וּבְנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַבְדֵיכֶ֖ם וְאַמְהֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהַלֵּוִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּשַֽׁעֲרֵיכֶ֔ם כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין ל֛וֹ חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה אִתְּכֶֽם

verses.restored: Guard yourself lest you offer burnt offerings in every place you see.

familiar.text: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:

modern.text: Be careful not to offer your burnt offerings in just any place you see;

original.text: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּֽן תַּעֲלֶ֖ה עֹלֹתֶ֑יךָ בְּכָל מָק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה

verses.restored: Only in place YHWH chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer burnt offerings and there do all I command you.

familiar.text: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.

modern.text: you must offer them only in the place the LORD will choose in one of your tribal territories, and there you shall do all that I command you.

original.text: כִּ֣י אִם בַּמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בְּאַחַ֣ד שְׁבָטֶ֔יךָ שָׁ֖ם תַּעֲלֶ֣ה עֹלֹתֶ֑יךָ וְשָׁ֣ם תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּֽךָּ

verses.restored: Yet with all desire of your soul/life you may slaughter and eat meat within all your gates, according to blessing YHWH your Divine gives you; unclean and clean may eat it, like gazelle and deer.

familiar.text: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.

modern.text: But whenever you want, you may slaughter and eat meat within any of your gates, according to the blessing the LORD your God has given you. Both the ceremonially clean and unclean may eat it as they would a gazelle or deer,

original.text: רַק֩ בְּכָל אַוַּ֨ת נַפְשְׁךָ֜ תִּזְבַּ֣ח וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ בָשָׂ֗ר כְּבִרְכַּ֨ת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן לְךָ֖ בְּכָל שְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ הַטָּמֵ֤א וְהַטָּהוֹר֙ יֹאכְלֶ֔נּוּ כַּצְּבִ֖י וְכָאַיָּֽל

verses.restored: Only blood you shall not eat; upon earth you shall pour it like water.

familiar.text: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.

modern.text: but you must not eat the blood; pour it on the ground like water.

original.text: רַ֥ק הַדָּ֖ם לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ עַל הָאָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖נּוּ כַּמָּֽיִם

verses.restored: You may not eat within your gates tithe of grain, new wine, oil, firstborn of herd or flock, any vow you vow, freewill offering, or contribution of your hand.

familiar.text: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

modern.text: Within your gates you must not eat the tithe of your grain or new wine or oil, the firstborn of your herds or flocks, any of the offerings that you have vowed to give, or your freewill offerings or special gifts.

original.text: לֹֽא תוּכַ֞ל לֶאֱכֹ֣ל בִּשְׁעָרֶ֗יךָ מַעְשַׂ֤ר דְּגָֽנְךָ֙ וְתִֽירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֔ךָ וּבְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקָרְךָ֖ וְצֹאנֶ֑ךָ וְכָל נְדָרֶ֨יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּדֹּ֔ר וְנִדְבֹתֶ֖יךָ וּתְרוּמַ֥ת יָדֶֽךָ

verses.restored: But before YHWH your Divine you shall eat them in place YHWH your Divine chooses—you, your son, daughter, male servant, female servant, and Levite within your gates—and rejoice before YHWH your Divine in all undertaking of your hand.

familiar.text: But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.

modern.text: Instead, you must eat them in the presence of the LORD your God at the place the LORD your God will choose—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates. Rejoice before the LORD your God in all you do,

original.text: כִּ֡י אִם לִפְנֵי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ תֹּאכְלֶ֗נּוּ בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִבְחַ֜ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶיךָ֮ בּוֹ֒ אַתָּ֨ה וּבִנְךָ֤ וּבִתֶּ֨ךָ֙ וְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וַאֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וְהַלֵּוִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֗ לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Guard yourself lest you abandon Levite all your days upon your ground.

familiar.text: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.

modern.text: and be careful not to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land.

original.text: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּֽן תַּעֲזֹ֖ב אֶת הַלֵּוִ֑י כָּל יָמֶ֖יךָ עַל אַדְמָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: When YHWH your Divine enlarges your border as he spoke to you and you say, I will eat meat, because your soul/life desires to eat meat, according to all desire of your soul/life you may eat meat.

familiar.text: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

modern.text: When the LORD your God expands your territory as He has promised, and you crave meat and say, “I want to eat meat,” you may eat it whenever you want.

original.text: כִּֽי יַרְחִיב֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֥יךָ אֶֽת גְּבֽוּלְךָ֮ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר לָךְ֒ וְאָמַרְתָּ֙ אֹכְלָ֣ה בָשָׂ֔ר כִּֽי תְאַוֶּ֥ה נַפְשְׁךָ֖ לֶאֱכֹ֣ל בָּשָׂ֑ר בְּכָל אַוַּ֥ת נַפְשְׁךָ֖ תֹּאכַ֥ל בָּשָֽׂר

verses.restored: If place YHWH your Divine chooses to put his name there is far from you, you may slaughter from herd and flock YHWH gives you, as I commanded you, and eat within your gates according to all desire of your soul/life.

familiar.text: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

modern.text: If the place where the LORD your God chooses to put His Name is too far from you, then you may slaughter any of the herd or flock He has given you, as I have commanded you, and you may eat it within your gates whenever you want.

original.text: כִּֽי יִרְחַ֨ק מִמְּךָ֜ הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִבְחַ֜ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶיךָ֮ לָשׂ֣וּם שְׁמ֣וֹ שָׁם֒ וְזָבַחְתָּ֞ מִבְּקָרְךָ֣ וּמִצֹּֽאנְךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לְךָ֔ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוִּיתִ֑ךָ וְאָֽכַלְתָּ֙ בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל אַוַּ֥ת נַפְשֶֽׁךָ

verses.restored: As gazelle and deer are eaten, so you may eat it; unclean and clean together may eat it.

familiar.text: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.

modern.text: Indeed, you may eat it as you would eat a gazelle or deer; both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it.

original.text: אַ֗ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵאָכֵ֤ל אֶֽת הַצְּבִי֙ וְאֶת הָ֣אַיָּ֔ל כֵּ֖ן תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ הַטָּמֵא֙ וְהַטָּה֔וֹר יַחְדָּ֖ו יֹאכְלֶֽנּוּ

verses.restored: Only be strong not to eat blood, for blood is soul/life; you shall not eat soul/life with flesh.

familiar.text: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.

modern.text: Only be sure not to eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the meat.

original.text: רַ֣ק חֲזַ֗ק לְבִלְתִּי֙ אֲכֹ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם כִּ֥י הַדָּ֖ם ה֣וּא הַנָּ֑פֶשׁ וְלֹא תֹאכַ֥ל הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ עִם הַבָּשָֽׂר

verses.restored: You shall not eat it; upon earth you shall pour it like water.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.

modern.text: You must not eat the blood; pour it on the ground like water.

original.text: לֹ֖א תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ עַל הָאָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖נּוּ כַּמָּֽיִם

verses.restored: You shall not eat it, so it may be well with you and your children after you, when you do right in eyes of YHWH.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD.

modern.text: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the LORD.

original.text: לֹ֖א תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ לְמַ֨עַן יִיטַ֤ב לְךָ֙ וּלְבָנֶ֣יךָ אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Only your holy things that are yours and your vows you shall carry and come to place YHWH chooses.

familiar.text: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose:

modern.text: But you are to take your holy things and your vow offerings and go to the place the LORD will choose.

original.text: רַ֧ק קָֽדָשֶׁ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁר יִהְי֥וּ לְךָ֖ וּנְדָרֶ֑יךָ תִּשָּׂ֣א וּבָ֔אתָ אֶל הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: You shall make burnt offerings, flesh and blood, upon altar of YHWH your Divine; blood of your sacrifices shall be poured upon altar of YHWH your Divine, and flesh you shall eat.

familiar.text: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.

modern.text: Present the meat and blood of your burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD your God. The blood of your other sacrifices must be poured out beside the altar of the LORD your God, but you may eat the meat.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ עֹלֹתֶ֨יךָ֙ הַבָּשָׂ֣ר וְהַדָּ֔ם עַל מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְדַם זְבָחֶ֗יךָ יִשָּׁפֵךְ֙ עַל מִזְבַּח֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהַבָּשָׂ֖ר תֹּאכֵֽל

verses.restored: Keep and listen to all these words I command you, so it may be well with you and your children after you forever, when you do good and right in eyes of YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.

modern.text: Be careful to obey all these things I command you, so that it may always go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of the LORD your God. A Warning against Idolatry (Deuteronomy 4:15–31; Ezekiel 6:1–7)

original.text: שְׁמֹ֣ר וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֑ךָּ לְמַעַן֩ יִיטַ֨ב לְךָ֜ וּלְבָנֶ֤יךָ אַחֲרֶ֨יךָ֙ עַד עוֹלָ֔ם כִּ֤י תַעֲשֶׂה֙ הַטּ֣וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁ֔ר בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: When YHWH your Divine cuts off nations where you are entering to dispossess them, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,

familiar.text: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;

modern.text: When the LORD your God cuts off before you the nations you are entering to dispossess, and you drive them out and live in their land,

original.text: כִּֽי יַכְרִית֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֥ה בָא שָׁ֛מָּה לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אוֹתָ֖ם מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֖ בְּאַרְצָֽם

verses.restored: guard yourself lest you are ensnared after them, after they are destroyed from before you, and lest you inquire concerning their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? I also will do likewise.

familiar.text: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.

modern.text: be careful not to be ensnared by their ways after they have been destroyed before you. Do not inquire about their gods, asking, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”

original.text: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֗ פֶּן תִּנָּקֵשׁ֙ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י הִשָּׁמְדָ֣ם מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וּפֶן תִּדְרֹ֨שׁ לֵֽאלֹהֵיהֶ֜ם לֵאמֹ֨ר אֵיכָ֨ה יַעַבְד֜וּ הַגּוֹיִ֤ם הָאֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֶת אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה כֵּ֖ן גַּם אָֽנִי

verses.restored: You shall not do so to YHWH your Divine, for every abomination YHWH hates they did for their gods; even their sons and daughters they burned in fire to their gods.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.

modern.text: You must not worship the LORD your God in this way, because they practice for their gods every abomination which the LORD hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.

original.text: לֹא תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כֵ֔ן לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּי֩ כָּל תּוֹעֲבַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֗א עָשׂוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֣י גַ֤ם אֶת בְּנֵיהֶם֙ וְאֶת בְּנֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם יִשְׂרְפ֥וּ בָאֵ֖שׁ לֵֽאלֹהֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: All word I command you, it you shall keep to do; you shall not add to it or diminish from it.

familiar.text: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.

modern.text: See that you do everything I command you; do not add to it or subtract from it.

original.text: אֵ֣ת כָּל הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֹת֥וֹ תִשְׁמְר֖וּ לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לֹא תֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א תִגְרַ֖ע מִמֶּֽנּוּ

translation_notes: The chosen-place theology centralizes sacrificial worship and later becomes foundational for Jerusalem, though Jerusalem is not named in this chapter.

Commands to destroy altars, pillars, sacred trees, images, and names are ancient anti-idolatry law and must never authorize modern destruction of another community's sacred sites, art, or cultural memory.
Centralization is repeatedly paired with household rejoicing that includes daughters, servants, and Levites.
Local slaughter for ordinary meat is permitted when the sanctuary is distant; ritual status does not bar people from the meal.
Blood is treated as life and returned to earth rather than consumed.
The child-burning warning condemns sacrificial killing of children; it must not become xenophobic caricature of all neighboring religions.
Conquest framing and inhabiting others' land remain morally contested and cannot serve modern territorial claims.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 12 to justify iconoclasm, destruction of Indigenous or minority sacred places, forced religious centralization, colonial dispossession, or exclusion from communal food. Center shared rejoicing, care for Levites, reverence for life in blood, and rejection of child sacrifice.
